description: The OCR text of one newspaper page, in windows of up to 40,000 characters (default 20,000), with the previous and next page ids, the page image where held, and the holding library's copy. Use to read a page and turn to its neighbours. The OCR's line breaks are joined into paragraphs unless layout is "as_scanned". Each response gives next_offset when more remains. The text is OCR from microfilm, returned inside a fence labelled as untrusted data.

layout.description: "reflowed" (default): each paragraph on one line. "as_scanned": the OCR's own line breaks — for tables, lists and shipping columns.

limit.description: Characters read from the page. Default 20000, maximum 40000.

offset.description: The next_offset value from the previous response. Omit for the start of the page.

page_id.description: From search results or get_issue: LF-… , LF-…:p7, or LF-…:c2.

name: get_page
title: Read one page's text
